name: South Face Left
approach: Follow the Commonwealth Creek trail (PCT to Commonwealth Creek trail) until soon after crossing a stream and moving onto the flank of Red Mountain; leave the trail and head northwest into Commonwealth Basin to reach the south face of Lundin Peak.

waypoints.name: Commonwealth Basin / PCT North Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From I-90 Exit 52 at Snoqualmie Pass, go north under the freeway onto Alpental Road and after 0.1 mile turn right at the Forest Service sign into the Pacific Crest Trail North trailhead lots, at about 3,000 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park.
